notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (TEM = minimo tabellare + ex-contingenza + EDR + Elemento Retributivo di Settore), confirmed by footnote in rinnovo PDF (11/11/2025), tabelle retributive p.99-100. Back-calculation: C1(01/01/2026)=1988.73/173=11.50 EUR/h; A1=1399.68/173=8.09 EUR/h; C3=2317.44/173=13.39 EUR/h — all consistent with divisor 173. base_salary = TEM; fixed_allowances=[] for levels A1-C3.

FIXED ALLOWANCES: C4 (7° livello) carries Elemento Retributivo di Settore EUR 59.39/month separate from TEM (rinnovo PDF p.97). D1 (Quadri) carries Indennità di Funzione EUR 98.13/month inclusive of the 59.39 ERS (rinnovo PDF + CCNL 12/11/2020 sezione Quadri). Both use TEM parametro=228, identical base_salary. The validator checks base_salary only so the equal values are valid.

SALARY TRANCHES: four tranches from rinnovo 11/11/2025 — 01/01/2026, 01/12/2026, 01/07/2027, 01/12/2028. Pre-rinnovo salary tables (CCNL 12/11/2020) not modelled; engine scope starts from first 2026 tranche.

NEW CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM: rinnovo 11/11/2025 Art. 23 introduces Professional Areas A-D (effective 01/07/2026). Old→new mapping: 1°→A1, 2°→A2, 3°→B1, 4°→B2, 5°→C1, 5°S→C2, 6°→C3, 7°→C4, Q→D1. TEM values are identical regardless of which code system is in use; engine uses new codes throughout.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Source: Art. 42, CCNL 12/11/2020. Quattordicesima not provided by this CCNL.

SENIORITY biennale (24 months), max 7 scatti, amounts from Art. 41 CCNL 12/11/2020: 6 of 9 levels confirmed (A2, B1, B2, C1, C3, C4); A1=A2 (21.54), C2=C1 (25.56) and D1=C4 (30.73) by adjacent-level approximation (1° livello, 5°S and Quadri absent from the Art. 41 table).

limitation.remediation: Source the Art. 41 amounts of 1° livello, 5°S and Quadri and replace the adjacent-level values.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP professionalizzante, under_classification (Art. 20 CCNL 12/11/2020): 36 months, first 18 months two levels below the destination, next 18 months one level below, then the destination. Track covers destinations B1, B2, C1, C2, C3; A1/A2 (no level two steps below), C4 and D1 (funzioni direttive/Quadri) are not destinations.

INPS: reuses the industria contribution table. SIMPLIFICATION: tax_sector='industria' is a modelling choice. Supporting facts: (a) Asstel is a Confindustria federation; (b) large TLC operators (Telecom Italia, etc.) have historically accessed CIGO/CIGS; (c) the CCNL itself (Art. 58 rinnovo 11/11/2025) describes the Fondo di Solidarietà Bilaterale TLC as 'in aggiunta' (supplementary), not as a CIG substitute. Counterargument: D.Lgs. 148/2015 Art. 26 bilateral funds are formally for sectors without CIG coverage; this was not verified against an INPS circular. The employer rate of the terziario table is about 1.2 points lower than the industria one in each headcount band of the bundle. The Fondo di Solidarietà Bilaterale (0.20% datore + 0.10% lavoratore) is NOT modelled in either case (review of 2026-10-30).

limitation.remediation: Verify the INPS classification of TLC employers and model the Fondo di Solidarieta Bilaterale TLC.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 42 - 13ª mensilità (p. 83): "Nel caso di inizio o di cessazione del rapporto di lavoro durante il corso dell'anno, il lavoratore non in prova ha diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare della tredicesima mensilità quanti sono i mesi di anzianità di servizio presso l’azienda. La frazione di mese superiore a quindici giorni va considerata a questi effetti come mese intero.". Match: more_than 15.

reviews.scope: The comporto and the sick pay of the CCNL counted over several illnesses (work_rules.sickness_rules), read on the signed text.
findings: Art. 36 (pp. 73-75) of the CCNL 12.11.2020: 180 days at the whole pay and 185 at 50%, summed over the three years before each new episode. The file kept 180 days of one illness: corrected to a cumulation over three years. A 2025 carenza reduction by event was seen only in a non-primary transcription and is not stored.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.quote: Nel caso di inizio o di cessazione del rapporto di lavoro durante il corso dell'anno, il lavoratore non in prova ha diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare della tredicesima mensilità quanti sono i mesi di anzianità di servizio presso l’azienda. La frazione di mese superiore a quindici giorni va considerata a questi effetti come mese intero.

provenance.transformation: Fractions of a month of more than 15 days count as a whole month.

levels.description: A1 — Grade 1, predominantly manual tasks requiring no professional knowledge
B1 — Grade 3, theoretical and practical knowledge of medium complexity
C1 — Grade 5, advanced professional and managerial capabilities with high-level knowledge
C2 — Grade 5S, specialist profiles with a high degree of specialisation
C3 — Grade 6, high and consolidated professional and managerial expertise
C4 — Grade 7, managerial functions of high organisational complexity
D1 — Quadri, maximum managerial and professional responsibility

location.section: Art. 36 - Trattamento in caso di malattia e infortunio non sul lavoro, cc. 10-11, 13
location.quote: 10. Nel caso di assenza per malattia al lavoratore non in prova assunto a tempo indeterminato sarà conservato il posto di lavoro per i periodi di tempo e con la retribuzione sotto specificati: [...] 180 giorni di calendario ad intera retribuzione; [...] 185 giorni di calendario al 50% della retribuzione. [...] 11. In ogni caso ove si verifichino più assenze per malattia o infortunio non sul lavoro, i trattamenti di cui al precedente punto 10 si intendono riferiti alle assenze complessivamente verificatesi nel periodo di tre anni precedente ogni nuovo ultimo episodio morboso.

provenance.transformation: Art. 36 cc. 10-11: the sick days of the three years before are summed; the job is kept 180 days at the whole pay and 185 at 50% (365 days), less the INPS share (c. 13). Stored as a cumulation of one band over a three-year window that ends on each sick day, as for the other CCNLs counting 'ogni nuovo ultimo episodio morboso'. Read on 2026-10-31.
provenance.note: Not modelled: the 120 more days of a continuous illness and the 120 days at 50% of the life-saving therapies; the hospital stays and the illnesses over 15 days paid in full outside the pay limits (60 days each, 90 together); the absences not counting for seniority that suspend the three years (c. 18); the carenza by event of the 2025 renewal, read only in a non-primary transcription.
